widget.instructions: Drag a vector's tip, or select it and type its size and direction in Precise controls.

args.text: Treat x and y separately: each obeys its own equation of motion.

stem: A particle starts at the origin with velocity {{v}} m/s along +y and has a constant acceleration of {{a}} m/s² along +x.
How far is it from the origin after {{t}} s?

hints.text: Treat the x and y motions separately.
x = ½aₓt² (from rest along x); y = v_y t (no acceleration along y).

missing-half-suvat.text: Along x it starts from rest, so x = ½aₓt². You left out the ½.

magnitudes-added.text: x and y are perpendicular displacements: combine them with Pythagoras, not by adding.

dimension-mismatch.text: Check the unit: the answer is a length.

generic.text: Find x and y separately, then √(x² + y²).

missing-half-suvat.front: Braking distance from u at deceleration a?
missing-half-suvat.back: u² ÷ (2a): the 2 comes from v² = u² + 2as.

magnitudes-added.front: Do vector magnitudes add when the vectors are perpendicular?
magnitudes-added.back: No. |a + b| = √(a² + b²) for perpendicular vectors.

generic.front: Motion with perpendicular velocity and acceleration?
generic.back: Treat each direction separately: x = ½at², y = vt; distance √(x² + y²).
